<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex023-2024-10-08-15-59" status="finalized">yang <rs type="person" ref="db:4189" ana="corpusmd:named_reference"><note type="gloss">lha rje</note>dags po</rs> na re byang chub sems dpa' rang la rgyun du zhugs pa <expan>la sogs</expan> pa'i don yod pas rngos kyi sgra yin gyi brtags pa ni ma yin zer ro || 
 'di ni rigs te nyan thos kyi skabs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyun ni laM yin la de la zhugs pas der 'jog pa mtshan nyid pa yin pa bzhin du | sangs rgyas kyi rgyun laM la zhugs pas der gzhag pa <expan>la sogs</expan> pa yang <pb edRef="inst:4454" n="82b"/><lb edRef="inst:4454" n="82b1"/> rngos su 'gyur bar rigs so || </seg></TEI>
